item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Tinubu directly manipulated electoral rules, INEC/election administration, or courts to entrench himself. The 2024 record I found is instead dominated by protest policing, treason charges, and press/cybercrime pressure, which are relevant to entrenchment but not the same as direct election-commission tampering. If you want, I can next do a narrower pass focused only on INEC, election petitions, Supreme Court, and appointment/removal of judges for any missing direct-entrenchment evidence.","evidence":[{"title":"Nigerian Government Warnings Raise Concerns about Upcoming Protests","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/29/nigerian-government-warnings-raise-concerns-about-upcoming-protests","summary":"HRW said senior officials and security agencies were already framing the planned August protests as politically motivated regime-change activity and warning of chaos and violence. That is negative evidence because it shows the state preparing a fear-based response to dissent rather than treating opposition as normal contestation.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Nigeria security forces deploy, government offers dialogue as protests loom","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-07-31","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462","summary":"Reuters reported that the government offered dialogue while security forces simultaneously deployed in major cities. This is mixed evidence: the public line included restraint, but the parallel coercive posture undercuts any claim of clean non-entrenching behavior.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason, inciting military","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-09-02","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Reuters reported treason and mutiny charges against protesters after the August demonstrations. That is strong negative evidence because the state escalated dissent into a security offense, which is consistent with intimidation and entrenchment rather than neutral rule-following.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.3","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Nigerian judge grants bail to 10 protesters charged with treason","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-09-11","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigerian-judge-grants-bail-to-10-protesters-charged-with-treason/2263258/","summary":"The court granted bail, but the underlying state action still matters: the case itself remained a punitive legal response to protest. This is useful as partial counterevidence only insofar as it shows the judiciary was not fully captured by the executive, but the entrenchment signal remains negative overall.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.4","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason, inciting military","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-09-02","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Reuters noted that the government framed the protests as destabilization and mutiny, and that the charges could carry the death penalty. This supports the reading that the administration used criminal law to discourage challenge, not just to keep order.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Police used excessive force to violently quash #Endbadgovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-11-28","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"Amnesty found at least 24 protesters killed and over 1,200 detained during the August crackdown. This is strong negative evidence for the lens because it shows security forces were used in a way that increased political control and fear rather than preserving open contestation.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9","3B.10"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House said the Cybercrimes Act’s cyberstalking provision had frequently been used against journalists and activists, and that legal pressure led to takedowns and self-censorship. This is strong negative evidence for media entrenchment: the state retained tools that chilled criticism and could be used to suppress scrutiny.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.3","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Repression of peaceful protest must end","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-10-01","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/10/nigeria-repression-of-peaceful-protest-must-end/","summary":"Amnesty said the government was using security personnel to deprive people of peaceful protest rights and urged release of those arrested in August. This reinforces the negative side: the administration’s response looked more like coercive retention of power than neutral tolerance.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Receives U.S. Ambassador, underscores importance of sustaining democracy, its norms and institutions","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-07-25","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-receives-u-s-ambassador-underscores-importance-of-sustaining-democracy-its-norms-and-institutions/","summary":"Tinubu said protests are part of democracy, while drawing a line against destruction of lives and property. This is the clearest pro-democratic rhetorical evidence I found in 2024, but it is general and does not show a concrete commitment to surrendering power through elections if defeated.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1","3B.8"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s broadcast on the nationwide protest","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-08-04","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged many protesters’ legitimate hopes, asked them to suspend demonstrations for dialogue, and told law enforcement to protect lives and property responsibly. This is the strongest restraint signal in the record, but it is reactive and paired with a broader crackdown, so it does not outweigh the coercive evidence.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9","3B.10"]}]}
